# Math Playground

> > Math Playground provides K-6 educational math games, logic puzzles, and problem-solving tools including Thinking Blocks and Puzzle Playground.

Math Playground LLC offers a comprehensive collection of interactive math games and activities designed to build mathematical thinking, spatial reasoning, and problem-solving skills for elementary and middle school students. The platform features proprietary tools like Thinking Blocks for visual problem-solving alongside engaging puzzles and practice games.
